research_question: Can registered semantic conformance relations detect historical deterministic implementation defects in public agent-evaluation pipelines that their pre-fix native tests did not expose?
claim_boundary: Any positive claim is limited to grader-local, contract-expressible false accepts and false rejects in the pinned public repositories, admitted historical implementation-fault lineages, and registered relation families. The study does not estimate the prevalence of defects in all benchmarks and does not claim to replace task-level or LLM-based auditing.

transformation_boundary.system_under_test: deterministic grader, evaluator adapter, replay path, or metric implementation
transformation_boundary.contract_source: independent public task schema, evaluator specification, or cross-entrypoint behavioral contract; never the fix diff

already_absorbed: benchmark-update meta-benchmarks for LLM defect detection
generic metamorphic testing without evaluator-specific empirical evidence
closest_prior_boundary.required_non_overlap: A deterministic, relation-based test method evaluated on author-acknowledged evaluator implementation fixes, with buggy/fixed replay and native-test comparison.

include_only_if: the official public repository has an identifiable direct parent and fix commit
the upstream change explicitly identifies an evaluator, scorer, parser, replay, adapter, or metric implementation defect
the defect can change a score, verdict, denominator, retry classification, or evaluation-path outcome
the same registered relation can be executed against the parent and fixed revisions
the repository license permits local execution and publication of derived measurements
exclude_if: the change only repairs task text, annotation, gold data, documentation, UI presentation, or model inference
the change intentionally changes the evaluation contract rather than repairing its implementation
the parent or fixed revision cannot be reconstructed without private artifacts
the probe relies on an LLM judge or on knowledge of the fix diff at execution time
the intervention transforms grader source rather than the graded artifact, trace, state, response, or invocation context
the lineage duplicates the same root cause and execution path as another admitted lineage

primary_endpoint.name: historical_fault_recall
primary_endpoint.detected_definition: The relation fails on the parent revision and passes on the fixed revision under the same probe and deterministic oracle.

comparators: native tests present at the parent revision
untyped input perturbation with an equal probe budget

bounded_probe.minimum_success_condition: At least 12 lineages from at least 3 repositories are admitted, and the method detects at least 3 lineages missed by parent-native tests across at least 2 repositories, with no fixed-revision false alarm among executed clean pairs.
kill_conditions: fewer than 12 independent reproducible lineages remain
fewer than 3 parent-native-test-missed defects are detected
all detections come from one repository
any executed relation still fails on the corresponding fixed revision without an independently documented remaining defect
the method requires per-lineage knowledge of the fix diff rather than a preregistered relation family

confirmatory_stage_if_probe_passes.split_policy: relation templates are frozen on 12 development lineages; final recall is reported on at least 24 root-cause lineages held out by repository or fault family
required_statistics: cluster bootstrap confidence interval by repository
paired exact or McNemar comparison against each baseline
false-alarm upper confidence bound on fixed revisions
required_baselines: native grader tests plus schema and static checks
STING-style test-strength diagnosis when technically applicable
confirmatory_stage_if_probe_passes.promotion_floor: At least 6 unique held-out defects beyond the strongest deterministic baseline, spanning at least 3 repositories, with a positive 95% confidence-interval lower bound and at most 1 fixed-control false alarm among 24 controls.
confirmatory_stage_if_probe_passes.gpu_use_boundary: GPU use is allowed only for an explicitly labeled local code-auditor comparator, never for the deterministic primary method.

integrity_rules: Do not count commit-message candidates as detected outcomes.
Do not transform grader source code and call the result evaluator conformance.
Do not split one fix commit into multiple sampling units unless independent root causes and probes are adjudicated before execution.
Do not add or remove lineages after viewing method or baseline outcomes.
Do not treat a passing post-fix regression test as evidence that the proposed method detected the historical defect.
Do not use codex_mock, synthetic fixtures, or AutoLabOS workflow smoke runs as paper evidence.
Publish negative and excluded cases with reasons.
